*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  READ_TAX_INFO                                       *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_tax_info.
  DATA:
    y_begda TYPE d,
    y_endda TYPE d.

  CLEAR: y_begda, y_endda.
  CLEAR: bupla_detail.

  IF object = 'X'.        "Year-end tax adjustment
    y_begda+0(4) = tax_year.
    y_begda+4(4) = '0101'.
    y_endda+0(4) = tax_year.
    y_endda+4(4) = '1231'.
  ELSEIF objectr = 'X'.   "Retirement tax adjustment
    y_begda+0(4) = ret_year.
    y_begda+4(4) = '0101'.
    y_endda+0(4) = ret_year.
    y_endda+4(4) = '1231'.
  ENDIF.

  rp_provide_from_last p0001 space y_begda y_endda.

  CALL FUNCTION 'HR_KR_BUSINESSPLACE_GET_DATA'
    EXPORTING
      pers_area                     = p0001-werks
      pers_subarea                  = p0001-btrtl
      mode                          = 'H'
      address_nation                = addr_version
    IMPORTING
      bus_place_detail              = bupla_detail
    EXCEPTIONS
      no_company_code_for_pers_area = 1
      no_busplace_for_subarea       = 2
      no_med_ins_assoc_for_subarea  = 3
      no_rep_busplace_for_mi_assoc  = 4
      no_entry_t7krbp_for_bupla     = 5
      no_businessplace_data         = 6
      illegal_mode                  = 7
      no_headquarter_busplace       = 8
      OTHERS                        = 9.
  CASE sy-subrc.
    WHEN 0.
    WHEN 6.
      PERFORM error_handling USING pernr-pernr '401'
                                   space space space space.
      REJECT.
    WHEN OTHERS.
      PERFORM error_handling USING pernr-pernr '403'
                                   space space space space.
      REJECT.
  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM. "READ_TAX_INFO

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  FILL_A_RECORD                                       *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_a_record.
  DATA: num_b TYPE i.

  num_b = 0.
  LOOP AT b_record.
    num_b = num_b + 1.
  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT a_record.
    MOVE num_b TO a_record-b_rec_num.
    MODIFY a_record.
  ENDLOOP.
  CHECK sy-subrc NE 0.

  MOVE: bupla_detail-bukrs      TO a_record-bukrs.

  MOVE: 'A'                     TO a_record-r_modif,
        '20'                    TO a_record-d_modif,
        bupla_detail-taxoff     TO a_record-tax_off,
        sum_dt                  TO a_record-submitdt,
        '2'                     TO a_record-agency,
        space                   TO a_record-agent_num,
        bupla_detail-stcd2      TO a_record-stcd2,
        bupla_detail-name       TO a_record-comnm,
        bupla_detail-stcd1      TO a_record-stcd1,
        bupla_detail-kr_repres  TO a_record-repres,
        num_b                   TO a_record-b_rec_num.

*<<<N2001151 Telephone of submitter
  IF sub_tele IS INITIAL.
    MOVE bupla_detail-phone_number TO a_record-ag_telnr.
  ELSE.
    MOVE sub_tele TO a_record-ag_telnr.
  ENDIF.
*>>>N2001151

* Period Class( Annual :1, anytime :2)
  IF object EQ 'X'.      "option for Year-end tax adjustment
    MOVE '1' TO a_record-target_prd.
  ELSEIF objectr EQ 'X'. "option for Retirement tax adjustment
    MOVE '2' TO a_record-target_prd.
  ENDIF.

  MOVE space  TO a_record-correction.
  MOVE space  TO a_record-aspace.
  MOVE space  TO a_record-aspace_p.
  APPEND a_record.
ENDFORM. "FILL_A_RECORD
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  FILL_B_RECORD                                       *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_b_record.
  DATA : num(12) TYPE n.
  STATICS seq    TYPE i.                        "LIUXIN20010327

  DATA : n_income(12)     TYPE n,               "KIMJEON200012
         n_tot_income(12) TYPE n.               "
  CLEAR: n_income,n_tot_income.                 "KIMJEON200012
  CLEAR b_record.

* LIUXIN20010316 BUPLA_DETAIL -> BUPLA_DETAIL_TAB
  READ TABLE bupla_detail_tab WITH KEY pernr-pernr.     "LIUXIN200103

  MOVE  bupla_detail_tab-bukrs             TO b_record-bukrs.

  MOVE: 'B'                            TO b_record-r_modif,
        '20'                           TO b_record-d_modif.

* Tax office
  MOVE: c_record-tax_off               TO b_record-tax_off.

* Sequence number
  SORT b_record BY tax_off stcd2 seqno DESCENDING.
  LOOP AT b_record WHERE tax_off = bupla_detail_tab-taxoff  "L9CK062877
                     AND stcd2   = bupla_detail_tab-stcd2.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.                           "It will be colltected
    b_record-seqno = 0.
  ELSE.
    seq = seq + 1.                            "LIUXIN20010327
    b_record-seqno = seq.                     "
  ENDIF.

  MOVE: bupla_detail_tab-stcd2             TO b_record-stcd2,
        bupla_detail_tab-name              TO b_record-comnm,
        bupla_detail_tab-kr_repres         TO b_record-repres,
        bupla_detail_tab-stcd1             TO b_record-stcd1.

* Num of c records
  MOVE 1               TO b_record-c_rec_num.

* Num of d records
  MOVE 0               TO b_record-d_rec_num.
  LOOP AT d_record WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr.
    b_record-d_rec_num = b_record-d_rec_num + 1.
    MOVE d_record-total TO n_income.               "KIMJEON200012
    ADD  n_income       TO n_tot_income.           "KIMJEON200012
  ENDLOOP.

  MOVE c_record-gross_tot TO n_income.             "KIMJEON200012
  ADD  n_income           TO n_tot_income.         "
  MOVE n_tot_income       TO b_record-tot_income.  "
  move_cnp c_record-dtr_itax   b_record-inc_tax.

  move_cnp c_record-dtr_stax   b_record-spe_tax.
  move_cnp c_record-dtr_rtax   b_record-res_tax.
  move_cnp c_record-dtr_tot    b_record-tot_tax.
  COLLECT b_record.
ENDFORM. " FILL_B_RECORD
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                      FILL_C_RECORD                                   *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_c_record.
  DATA : count  TYPE i,
         betrg_c(12) TYPE c.

  CLEAR c_record.

* Prepare internal tables
* LIUXIN20010316 BUPLA_DETAIL -> BUPLA_DETAIL_TAB
  READ TABLE bupla_detail_tab WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  READ TABLE employee WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  READ TABLE otab     WITH KEY pernr-pernr.

* Sequence number
  SORT c_record BY bukrs tax_off seqno DESCENDING.
  READ TABLE c_record WITH KEY bukrs   = bupla_detail_tab-bukrs
*                          TAX_OFF     = BUPLA_DETAIL_TAB-KR_TAXOFF.
                           tax_off     = bupla_detail_tab-taxoff.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    MOVE c_record-seqno TO count.
    count = count + 1.
  ELSE.
    count = 1.
  ENDIF.

* Resient/Non-resident - Foreigner
  CLEAR krtax.
  READ TABLE krtax WITH KEY infty = '0541'.

* Data management number
  MOVE pernr-pernr          TO c_record-pernr.
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-bukrs   TO c_record-bukrs.
  MOVE 'C'                  TO c_record-r_modif.
  MOVE '20'                 TO c_record-d_modif.

* Tax office
*  MOVE BUPLA_DETAIL_TAB-KR_TAXOFF TO C_RECORD-TAX_OFF.
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-taxoff TO c_record-tax_off.         "L9CK062877

* Sequence number
  MOVE count                 TO c_record-seqno.

* Business number
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-stcd2    TO c_record-stcd2.



* Earner infomation
  PERFORM count_prevous_employer
                        CHANGING c_record-pre_com_num.
  IF krtax-rsnot EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '2' TO  c_record-rsd_mod.         "Non-resident
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' TO  c_record-rsd_mod.         "Resident
  ENDIF.

* MOVE-CORRESPONDING EMPLOYEE TO C_RECORD.
  MOVE employee-begda     TO c_record-y_begda.
  MOVE employee-endda     TO c_record-y_endda.
  MOVE employee-regno     TO c_record-regno.
  MOVE employee-ename     TO c_record-ename.
*  move employee-pstlz     to c_record-pstlz.
*  move employee-addre     to c_record-addre.
  MOVE employee-r_begda   TO c_record-red_begda.
  MOVE employee-r_endda   TO c_record-red_endda.

  IF krtax-fryea EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '9' TO  c_record-for_mod.        "Foreigner
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' TO  c_record-for_mod.        "National
  ENDIF.


* Num of dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE infty = '0540' AND dptid = 'X'.
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record-bas_dp_n.

* Num of old dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  ( infty = '0541' AND oldee = 'X' )
                    OR ( infty = '0540' AND oldid = 'X' ).
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record-add_old_n.

* Num of handicapped
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  ( infty = '0541' AND hndee = 'X' )
                    OR ( infty = '0540' AND hndid = 'X' ).
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record-add_hand_n.

* Num of child dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  infty = '0540' AND chdid = 'X'.
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record-add_child_n.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING otab TO c_record.

  LOOP AT income WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr AND    "KIMJEON200012
                       seqno = 0.
    MOVE income-regular      TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record-wtm_gross.
    MOVE income-bonus        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record-wts_gross.
    MOVE income-ackbn        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record-wti_gross.
    MOVE income-total        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record-gross_tot.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF rgdir-occat = pkr99_occ_ret_w_reg  OR
     rgdir-occat = pkr99_occ_ret_wo_reg.
    MOVE employee-endda TO c_record-receiv_dt.
  ELSE.
    MOVE sum_dt TO c_record-receiv_dt.
  ENDIF.

  MOVE space TO c_record-correction.
  MOVE space TO c_record-space_3.

  APPEND c_record.
ENDFORM. " FILL_C_RECORD

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  COUNT_PREVOUS_EMPLOYER                              *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM count_prevous_employer CHANGING count.
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT income WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr.
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    count = count - 1.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. "COUNT_PREVOUS_EMPLOYER

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  FILL_D_RECORD                                       *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_d_record.
  DATA : num1 TYPE i,
         num2 TYPE i,
         betrg_c(12)  TYPE c,
         betrg_n(12)  TYPE n.

  CLEAR d_record.

  num2  = 0.
  LOOP AT income WHERE seqno > 0 AND pernr = pernr-pernr.
    num2 = num2 + 1.              "Num of records(per employee)

    MOVE pernr-pernr          TO d_record-pernr.
    MOVE c_record-bukrs       TO d_record-bukrs.

    MOVE : 'D'                TO d_record-r_modif,
           '20'               TO d_record-d_modif,
           c_record-tax_off   TO d_record-tax_off,
           c_record-seqno     TO d_record-seqno.

    MOVE : c_record-stcd2     TO d_record-stcd2,
           space              TO d_record-pre_space.

    MOVE : c_record-regno     TO d_record-regno.

    MOVE : income-workplace   TO d_record-workplace,
           income-buzinum     TO d_record-buzinum.

    MOVE   income-regular     TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-regular.

    MOVE   income-bonus       TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-bonus.

    MOVE   income-ackbn       TO betrg_c.          "KIMJEON200011
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-ibn01.

    MOVE   income-total       TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-total.

    MOVE   num2               TO d_record-d_seqno.
    MOVE   space              TO d_record-correction.
    MOVE   space              TO d_record-dspace.
    APPEND d_record.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " FILL_D_RECORD
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  FILL_B_RECORD_01                                     *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_b_record_01.
  DATA : num(12) TYPE n.
  STATICS seq    TYPE i.

  DATA : n_income(12)     TYPE n,
         n_tot_income(12) TYPE n.
  CLEAR: n_income,n_tot_income.
  CLEAR b_record.

  READ TABLE bupla_detail_tab WITH KEY pernr-pernr.

  MOVE  bupla_detail_tab-bukrs      TO b_record-bukrs.

  MOVE: 'B'                         TO b_record-r_modif,
        '20'                        TO b_record-d_modif.

* Tax office
  MOVE: c_record_1-tax_off          TO b_record-tax_off.

* Sequence number
  SORT b_record BY tax_off stcd2 seqno DESCENDING.
  LOOP AT b_record WHERE tax_off = bupla_detail_tab-taxoff
                     AND stcd2   = bupla_detail_tab-stcd2.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    b_record-seqno = 0.
  ELSE.
    seq = seq + 1.
    b_record-seqno = seq.
  ENDIF.

  MOVE: bupla_detail_tab-stcd2      TO b_record-stcd2,
        bupla_detail_tab-name       TO b_record-comnm,
        bupla_detail_tab-kr_repres  TO b_record-repres,
        bupla_detail_tab-stcd1      TO b_record-stcd1.

* Num of c records
  MOVE 1                            TO b_record-c_rec_num.

* Num of d records
  MOVE 0                            TO b_record-d_rec_num.
  LOOP AT d_record WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr.
    b_record-d_rec_num = b_record-d_rec_num + 1.
    MOVE d_record-total_1           TO n_income.
    ADD  n_income                   TO n_tot_income.
  ENDLOOP.

  MOVE c_record_1-gross_tot         TO n_income.
  ADD  n_income                     TO n_tot_income.
  MOVE n_tot_income                 TO b_record-tot_income.
  move_cnp c_record_1-dtr_itax   b_record-inc_tax.

  move_cnp c_record_1-dtr_stax   b_record-spe_tax.
  move_cnp c_record_1-dtr_rtax   b_record-res_tax.
  move_cnp c_record_1-dtr_tot    b_record-tot_tax.
  COLLECT b_record.
ENDFORM. " FILL_B_RECORD_01
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                      FILL_C_RECORD_01                                 *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_c_record_01.
  DATA : count        TYPE i,
         betrg_c(12)  TYPE c.

  CLEAR c_record_1.

* Prepare internal tables
  READ TABLE bupla_detail_tab WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  READ TABLE employee WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  READ TABLE otab     WITH KEY pernr-pernr.

* Sequence number
  SORT c_record_1 BY bukrs tax_off seqno DESCENDING.
  READ TABLE c_record_1 WITH KEY bukrs   = bupla_detail_tab-bukrs
*                          TAX_OFF     = BUPLA_DETAIL_TAB-KR_TAXOFF.
                           tax_off     = bupla_detail_tab-taxoff.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    MOVE c_record_1-seqno TO count.
    count = count + 1.
  ELSE.
    count = 1.
  ENDIF.

* Resient/Non-resident - Foreigner
  CLEAR krtax.
  READ TABLE krtax WITH KEY infty = '0541'.

* Data management number
  MOVE pernr-pernr              TO c_record_1-pernr.
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-bukrs   TO c_record_1-bukrs.
  MOVE 'C'                      TO c_record_1-r_modif.
  MOVE '20'                     TO c_record_1-d_modif.

* Tax office
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-taxoff TO c_record_1-tax_off.

* Sequence number
  MOVE count                    TO c_record_1-seqno.

* Business number
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-stcd2   TO c_record_1-stcd2.

* Earner infomation
  PERFORM count_prevous_employer
                        CHANGING c_record_1-pre_com_num.
  IF krtax-rsnot EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '2' TO  c_record_1-rsd_mod.           "Non-resident
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' TO  c_record_1-rsd_mod.           "Resident
  ENDIF.

  MOVE employee-begda     TO c_record_1-y_begda.
  MOVE employee-endda     TO c_record_1-y_endda.
  MOVE employee-regno     TO c_record_1-regno.
  MOVE employee-ename     TO c_record_1-ename.
  MOVE employee-r_begda   TO c_record_1-red_begda.
  MOVE employee-r_endda   TO c_record_1-red_endda.

  IF krtax-fryea EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '9' TO  c_record_1-for_mod.            "Foreigner
    MOVE employee-curcd TO c_record_1-curcd.
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' TO  c_record_1-for_mod.            "National
  ENDIF.

* Num of dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE infty = '0540' AND subty <> '1' AND dptid = 'X'.
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record_1-bas_dp_n.

* Num of old dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  ( infty = '0541' AND oldee = 'X' )
                    OR ( infty = '0540' AND oldid = 'X' ).
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record_1-add_old_n.

* Num of handicapped
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  ( infty = '0541' AND hndee = 'X' )
                    OR ( infty = '0540' AND hndid = 'X' ).
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record_1-add_hand_n.

* Num of child dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  infty = '0540' AND chdid = 'X'.
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record_1-add_child_n.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING otab TO c_record_1.

  LOOP AT income WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr AND
                       seqno = 0.
    MOVE income-regular      TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_1-wtm_gross.
    MOVE income-bonus        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_1-wts_gross.
    MOVE income-ackbn        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_1-wti_gross.
    MOVE income-total        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_1-gross_tot.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF rgdir-occat = pkr99_occ_ret_w_reg  OR
     rgdir-occat = pkr99_occ_ret_wo_reg.
    MOVE employee-endda TO c_record_1-receiv_dt.
  ELSE.
    MOVE sum_dt TO c_record_1-receiv_dt.
  ENDIF.

  MOVE: space TO c_record_1-space_1,
        space TO c_record_1-correction,
        space TO c_record_1-space_3.

  APPEND c_record_1.
ENDFORM. " FILL_C_RECORD_01
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  FILL_D_RECORD_01                                     *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_d_record_01.
  DATA : num1 TYPE i,
         num2 TYPE i,
         betrg_c(12)  TYPE c,
         betrg_n(12)  TYPE n.

  CLEAR d_record.

  num2  = 0.
  LOOP AT income WHERE seqno > 0 AND pernr = pernr-pernr.
    num2 = num2 + 1.              "Num of records(per employee)

    MOVE pernr-pernr          TO d_record-pernr.
    MOVE c_record_1-bukrs     TO d_record-bukrs.

    MOVE : 'D'                TO d_record-r_modif,
           '20'               TO d_record-d_modif,
           c_record_1-tax_off TO d_record-tax_off,
           c_record_1-seqno   TO d_record-seqno.

    MOVE : c_record_1-stcd2   TO d_record-stcd2,
           space              TO d_record-pre_space.

    MOVE : c_record_1-regno   TO d_record-regno.

    MOVE : income-workplace   TO d_record-workplace,
           income-buzinum     TO d_record-buzinum.

    MOVE   income-regular     TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-regular_1.

    MOVE   income-bonus       TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-bonus_1.

    MOVE   income-ackbn       TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-ibn01_1.

    MOVE   income-total       TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-total_1.

    MOVE   num2               TO d_record-d_seqno.
    MOVE   space              TO d_record-correction.
    MOVE   space              TO d_record-dspace.
    MOVE   space              TO d_record-dspace_p.
    APPEND d_record.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " FILL_D_RECORD_01

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  FILL_A_RECORD_04                                    *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_a_record_04.
  DATA : num_b TYPE i.

  num_b = 0.
  LOOP AT b_record.
    num_b = num_b + 1.
  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT a_record.
    MOVE num_b TO a_record-b_rec_num.
    MODIFY a_record.
  ENDLOOP.
  CHECK sy-subrc NE 0.

  MOVE: bupla_detail-bukrs             TO a_record-bukrs.

  MOVE: 'A'                            TO a_record-r_modif,
        '20'                           TO a_record-d_modif,
        bupla_detail-taxoff            TO a_record-tax_off,
        sum_dt                         TO a_record-submitdt,
        '2'                            TO a_record-agency,
        space                          TO a_record-agent_num,

        bupla_detail-stcd2             TO a_record-stcd2,
        bupla_detail-name              TO a_record-comnm,
* YUX796286
        tax_id                         TO a_record-home_tax_id,
        sub_dept                       TO a_record-sub_dept,
        sub_name                       TO a_record-sub_name,
* YUX796286
        num_b                          TO a_record-b_rec_num.

  MOVE  '101'                          TO a_record-hangle_code.

*<<<N2001151 Telephone of submitter
  IF sub_tele IS INITIAL.
    MOVE bupla_detail-phone_number TO a_record-ag_telnr.
  ELSE.
    MOVE sub_tele TO a_record-ag_telnr.
  ENDIF.
*>>>N2001151

* Code for submit type
*Note 1085909 begin.
*  IF object EQ 'X'.
*    MOVE '2' TO a_record-target_prd.
*  ELSEIF objectr EQ 'X'.
*    MOVE '1' TO a_record-target_prd.
*  ENDIF.

* Period Class( Annual :1, anytime :2)
  IF object EQ 'X'.      "option for Year-end tax adjustment
    MOVE '1' TO a_record-target_prd.
  ELSEIF objectr EQ 'X'. "option for Retirement tax adjustment
*BAIW1125745    MOVE '2' TO a_record-target_prd.
    MOVE '1' TO a_record-target_prd.  "BAIW1125745 '2' means bankrupt
  ENDIF.
*Note 1085909 end.

  MOVE space  TO a_record-aspace_2.
  MOVE space  TO a_record-aspace_8.                 "JINQUE1289311 YEA08
  APPEND a_record.
ENDFORM. "fill_a_record_04

FORM fill_b_record_04. "NANL9CK079497
  DATA : num(12) TYPE n.
  STATICS seq    TYPE i.                   "LIUXIN20010327

  CLEAR b_record.

  ELSE.

  MOVE '0000000000000'       TO b_record-legal_tax.         "YUX796286
* move_cnp c_record-gross_tot  b_record-tot_income."KIMJEON200012

* move 0                to legal_tax.

  move_cnp c_record_04-dtr_tot    b_record-tot_tax.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  FILL_D_RECORD_04                                    *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_d_record_04.
  DATA : num1 TYPE i,
         num2 TYPE i,
         betrg_c(12)  TYPE c,
         betrg_n(12)  TYPE n.
*   begin BAIW1136814
  DATA : tembuznum    like p0542-bus01.
*   end BAIW1136814
  CLEAR d_record.

  num2  = 0.
  LOOP AT income WHERE seqno > 0 AND pernr = pernr-pernr.
    num2 = num2 + 1.              "Num of records(per employee)

    MOVE pernr-pernr            TO d_record-pernr.
    MOVE c_record_04-bukrs      TO d_record-bukrs.

    MOVE : 'D'                  TO d_record-r_modif,
           '20'                 TO d_record-d_modif,
           c_record_04-tax_off  TO d_record-tax_off,
           c_record_04-seqno    TO d_record-seqno.

    MOVE : c_record_04-stcd2    TO d_record-stcd2,
           space                TO d_record-pre_space.

    MOVE : c_record_04-regno    TO d_record-regno.

    MOVE : income-workplace   TO d_record-workplace,
*   begin BAIW1136814
*           income-buzinum     TO d_record-buzinum.
           income-buzinum     TO tembuznum.
*    Search tembuznum FOR '-'.
*    if sy-subrc = 0.
*      replace all OCCURRENCES OF '-' in tembuznum with ''.
*    endif.
    DO.
      REPLACE '-'  WITH '' INTO tembuznum.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    condense tembuznum no-gaps.
    MOVE   tembuznum          TO d_record-buzinum.
*   end BAIW1136814
    MOVE   income-regular     TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-regular_1.

    MOVE   income-bonus       TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-bonus_1.

    MOVE   income-ackbn       TO betrg_c.          "KIMJEON200011
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-ibn01_1.

*N1133208 YANGQ insert begin.
    MOVE   income-stkbn       TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-stock_option.
*N1133208 YANGQ insert end.

    MOVE   income-total       TO betrg_c.
    MOVE   betrg_c            TO d_record-total_1.

    MOVE   num2               TO d_record-d_seqno.
    MOVE   space              TO d_record-dspace_1.
    APPEND d_record.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " FILL_D_RECORD_04

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  CREATE_DME_FILE                                     *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM create_dme_file.
  LOOP AT a_record.
    PERFORM dataset_init USING a_record-stcd2 a_record-comnm
                         CHANGING temse_open.
    "<<< N2108719 YEA DME 2014
    IF taxation_year GE '2014'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2014.
    ">>> N2108719 YEA DME 2014
    "<<< N1935023 YEA DME 2013
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2013'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2013.
    ">>> N1935023 YEA DME 2013
    "<<< N1800801 Terry Begin
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2012'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2012.
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2011'.
    ">>> N1800801 Terry End
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2011.
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2010'.                     "N1546031
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2010.                      "N1546031
    "<<< LQ 2009YEA DME Note 1415937 Start
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2009'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2009.
    ">>> LQ 2009YEA DME Note 1415937 End
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2008'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2008.
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2007'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2007.
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2006'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2006.
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2005'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2005.
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2004'.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2004.                      "N893541
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2002'.                     "NAN616245
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2002.                      "NAN616245
    ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2001'.                     "<<< N2584059
      PERFORM write_to_temse_2001.                    "NANL9CK079497
    ELSEIF taxation_year LT '2001'.                   "NANL9CK079497
      PERFORM write_to_temse.
    ENDIF.                                              ">>> N2584059
    PERFORM close_dataset.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. "CREATE_DME_FILE

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM INIT_DATASET                                             *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM dataset_init USING p_biz_no TYPE char10
                            p_company TYPE text60       "N2685958
                   CHANGING p_created TYPE boole_d.

  CLEAR: p_created, objin.

  objin+10(1)   = 'C'.
  objin+11(10)  = p_biz_no.
  objin+25(8)   = 'HKRCYEA0'.

  CALL FUNCTION 'RP_TS_CREATE_OBJECT'
    EXPORTING
      objkn                   = objkn
      objnr                   = $objnr
      empfg                   = empfg
      objin                   = objin
    IMPORTING
      objhd                   = objhd
      tsobj                   = tsobj
    EXCEPTIONS
      fb_call_handle          = 1
      fb_error                = 2
      fb_rsts_noconv          = 3
      fb_rsts_other           = 4
      no_object               = 5
      no_permission           = 6
      fb_nr_no_object         = 7
      fb_nr_not_intern        = 8
      fb_nr_not_found         = 9
      fb_object_already_exist = 10

      OTHERS                  = 12.

  CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.

  temse_file_info-stcd2   = p_biz_no.
  temse_file_info-comnm   = p_company.
  temse_file_info-filenm  = tsobj.
  APPEND temse_file_info.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM WRITE_TO_TEMSE                                           *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       ........                                                      *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse.

  CHECK temse_open = true.
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record USING 'A'.

  SORT b_record BY bukrs seqno.
  SORT c_record BY bukrs tax_off seqno.
  SORT d_record BY bukrs tax_off seqno d_seqno.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record USING 'B'.
    LOOP AT c_record WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                       AND stcd2   = b_record-stcd2
                       AND bukrs   = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record USING 'C'.
      LOOP AT d_record  WHERE pernr = c_record-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record USING 'D'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. "WRITE_TO_TEMSE

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       ........                                                      *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  RECORDNAME                                                    *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_record USING recordname.
  CLEAR datafile. REFRESH datafile.

  CASE recordname.
    WHEN 'A'.
      PERFORM add_arecord_to_datafile.
    WHEN 'B'.
      PERFORM add_brecord_to_datafile.
    WHEN 'C'.
      PERFORM add_crecord_to_datafile.
    WHEN 'D'.
      PERFORM add_drecord_to_datafile.
  ENDCASE.
*  APPEND datafile.  NAN628548
  CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
    EXPORTING
      fbhandle = objhd
    TABLES
      datatab  = datafile.

ENDFORM. " WRITE_TO_TEMSE_RECORD

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*              ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE                                 *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_arecord_to_datafile.
  MOVE :   a_record-r_modif        TO datafile+0(1),
           a_record-d_modif        TO datafile+1(2),
           a_record-tax_off        TO datafile+3(3),
           a_record-submitdt       TO datafile+6(8),
           a_record-agency         TO datafile+14(1),
           a_record-agent_num      TO datafile+15(6),
           a_record-stcd2          TO datafile+21(10),
           a_record-comnm          TO datafile+31(40),
           a_record-stcd1          TO datafile+71(13),
           a_record-repres         TO datafile+84(30),
*            a_record-ag_pstlz       to datafile+114(10),
*            a_record-address_line   to datafile+124(70),
           a_record-ag_telnr       TO datafile+114(15).

  UNPACK   a_record-b_rec_num      TO datafile+129(5).

  MOVE :   a_record-hangle_code    TO datafile+134(3),
           a_record-target_prd     TO datafile+137(1),
           a_record-correction     TO datafile+138(1),
           a_record-aspace         TO datafile+139(511).
  MOVE     'P'                     TO datafile+649(1).

* Unicode NAN628548
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile+0(71)  71.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile+71(43) 43.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile+114(536) 536.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile. REFRESH datafile.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM. "ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE

* Unicode NAN628548
  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream

    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile+62(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafile+92(558) 558.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafile. REFRESH datafile.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafile.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafile.
  ENDIF.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb+0(125)  125.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb+125(605) 605.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafileb. REFRESH datafileb.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafileb.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafileb.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM. " ADD_DRECORD_TO_DATAFILE_2004

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  fill_c_record_05
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
* For legal change 2005 nis 893541
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_c_record_05 .
  DATA : count        TYPE i,
         betrg_c(12)  TYPE c.
  DATA : tax_method    TYPE c.                      "JINQ1149458
  CLEAR c_record_04.

* Prepare internal tables
* LIUXIN20010316 BUPLA_DETAIL -> BUPLA_DETAIL_TAB
  READ TABLE bupla_detail_tab WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  READ TABLE employee WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  READ TABLE otab     WITH KEY pernr-pernr.

* Sequence number
* SORT c_record_04 BY bukrs tax_off seqno DESCENDING.
  sort c_record_04 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno descending.
  READ TABLE c_record_04 WITH KEY bukrs   = bupla_detail_tab-bukrs
*                          TAX_OFF     = BUPLA_DETAIL_TAB-KR_TAXOFF.
                              stcd2       = bupla_detail_tab-stcd2
                              tax_off     = bupla_detail_tab-taxoff.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    MOVE c_record_04-seqno TO count.
    count = count + 1.
  ELSE.
    count = 1.
  ENDIF.

* Resient/Non-resident - Foreigner
  CLEAR krtax.
  READ TABLE krtax WITH KEY infty = '0541'.

* Data management number
  MOVE pernr-pernr              TO c_record_04-pernr.
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-bukrs   TO c_record_04-bukrs.
  MOVE 'C'                      TO c_record_04-r_modif.
  MOVE '20'                     TO c_record_04-d_modif.

* Tax office
*  MOVE BUPLA_DETAIL_TAB-KR_TAXOFF TO C_RECORD_1-TAX_OFF.
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-taxoff TO c_record_04-tax_off.      "L9CK062877

* Sequence number
  MOVE count                    TO c_record_04-seqno.

* Business number
  MOVE bupla_detail_tab-stcd2   TO c_record_04-stcd2.

* Earner infomation
  PERFORM count_prevous_employer
                        CHANGING c_record_04-pre_com_num.
  IF krtax-rsnot EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '2' TO  c_record_04-rsd_mod.           "Non-resident
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' TO  c_record_04-rsd_mod.           "Resident
  ENDIF.


  MOVE employee-begda     TO c_record_04-y_begda.
  MOVE employee-endda     TO c_record_04-y_endda.
  MOVE employee-regno     TO c_record_04-regno.
  MOVE employee-ename     TO c_record_04-ename.
  MOVE employee-r_begda   TO c_record_04-red_begda.
  MOVE employee-r_endda   TO c_record_04-red_endda.

  MOVE space TO c_record_04-curcd.                          "N1141528
  IF krtax-fryea EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '9' TO  c_record_04-for_mod.           "Foreigner
    MOVE employee-curcd TO c_record_04-curcd.               "NAN574236
  ELSE.
    MOVE '1' TO  c_record_04-for_mod.           "National
  ENDIF.


* Num of dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE infty = '0540' AND subty <> '1' AND dptid = 'X'.
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record_04-bas_dp_n.

* Num of old dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  ( infty = '0541' AND oldee = 'X' )
                    OR ( infty = '0540' AND oldid = 'X' ).
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record_04-add_old_n.

* Num of handicapped
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  ( infty = '0541' AND hndee = 'X' )
                    OR ( infty = '0540' AND hndid = 'X' ).
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record_04-add_hand_n.

* Num of child dependants
  count = 0.
  LOOP AT krtax WHERE  infty = '0540' AND chdid = 'X'.
    count = count + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  MOVE count TO c_record_04-add_child_n.

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING otab TO c_record_04.

  move otab-congr_con+0(10) to c_record_04-congr_con.

  LOOP AT income WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr AND    "KIMJEON200012
                       seqno = 0.
    MOVE income-regular      TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_04-wtm_gross.
    MOVE income-bonus        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_04-wts_gross.
    MOVE income-ackbn        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_04-wti_gross.
*N1133208 YANGQ insert begin.
    MOVE income-stkbn        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_04-stock_option.
*N1133208 YANGQ insert end.
    MOVE income-total        TO betrg_c.
    MOVE betrg_c             TO c_record_04-gross_tot.
  ENDLOOP.

* YUX796286
*  if rgdir-occat = pkr99_occ_ret_w_reg  or
*     rgdir-occat = pkr99_occ_ret_wo_reg.
*    move employee-endda to c_record_04-receiv_dt.
*  else.
*    move sum_dt to c_record_04-receiv_dt.
*  endif.

*  move: space to c_record_04-space_1,
*        space to c_record_04-correction,
*        space to c_record_04-space_3.

* Read tax calculation method
  move '2'              to c_record_04-tax_method.
  rp_provide_from_last p0541 space begda endda.
  if pnp-sw-found eq 1.
*    if p0541-optio = 'A'.                                    "JINQ1149458
    PERFORM check_tax_method CHANGING tax_method.             "JINQ1149458
    if tax_method = 'A'.                                      "JINQ1149458
      move '1'              to c_record_04-tax_method.
    endif.
  endif.

  c_record_04-cspace_4 = '00000000'.
  c_record_04-cspace_5 = '00000000'.
  c_record_04-cspace10 = '0000000000'. "BAIW1125745 YEA 2007 Phase II

* Total Deduction:
* item48 = Item41+ Item 42+ Item 43+ Item 44+ Item 45+ Item 46
  c_record_04-ded_total = c_record_04-ded_si   + c_record_04-ded_medi +
                          c_record_04-ded_edu  + c_record_04-ded_hous +
                          c_record_04-ded_dona + c_record_04-congr_con.

*BAIW1125745 Beg. Exlude retirement from total since 2007
  IF taxation_year GE '2007'.
    c_record_04-ded_tot2 = c_record_04-ded_indiv + c_record_04-ded_pps +
                         c_record_04-dd_invest + c_record_04-ded_card +
                         c_record_04-ded_stck.
  ELSE.
    c_record_04-ded_tot2 = c_record_04-ded_indiv + c_record_04-ded_pps +
                         c_record_04-dd_invest + c_record_04-ded_card +
                         c_record_04-ded_stck + c_record_04-ded_retr_05.
  ENDIF.
*BAIW1125745 End.

* YUX796286
* begin legal change 2005 nis 893541
  move c_record_04-after_spec to c_record_04-after_spec_05.
  if c_record_04-ded_stck >= 0.
    c_record_04-ded_stck_05 = 0.
  else.
    c_record_04-ded_stck_05 = 1.
  endif.
  if c_record_04-ded_tot2 >= 0.
    c_record_04-tot_flag_05 = 0.
  else.
    c_record_04-tot_flag_05 = 1.
  endif.
  move c_record_04-tax_base to c_record_04-tax_base_05.
  move otab-ret_pen to  c_record_04-ded_retr_05.
  move otab-cash_tot to c_record_04-cas_rece_05.
* end legal change 2005 nis 893541

  move space to c_record_04-cspace_06.        "YEA2006 huangnic N1018548

  APPEND c_record_04.

ENDFORM. " fill_c_record_05
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  fill_e_record_05
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
* For legal change 2005 nis 893541
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* begin legal change 2005 nis 893541
FORM fill_e_record_05 .
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <Relation> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <Name> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <Reg_no> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <forei> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <bas_ded> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <had_ded> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <chi_ded> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <ins_ded> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <med_ded> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <edu_ded> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <cre_ded> type any.

  Data: Seq_num(4) type n,
        count_num(2) type n,
        foreflag type n,
        checkval TYPE c VALUE '1',
        checkspa TYPE c VALUE space,
        age_endda  like p0001-begda,        " for the age
        AGE_YEARS TYPE P,
        str_tmp type string.

  CLEAR e_record_05.
  Seq_num = 1.
  count_num = 1.
* the age is calculated basing on the last day of taxation year.
  age_endda      = taxation_year+0(4).
  age_endda+4(4) = '1231'.

* fill the data management  Obligator Earner
*  MOVE pernr-pernr            TO  e_record_05-pernr.
*  MOVE c_record_04-bukrs      TO  e_record_05-bukrs.
*  MOVE : 'E'                  TO  e_record_05-r_modif,
*         '20'                 TO  e_record_05-d_modif,
*         c_record_04-tax_off  TO  e_record_05-tax_off,
*         c_record_04-seqno    TO  e_record_05-seqno.
*  MOVE : c_record_04-stcd2    TO  e_record_05-stcd2,
*           space              TO  e_record_05-pre_space.
*  MOVE : c_record_04-regno    TO  e_record_05-regno.
*  MOVE   c_record_04-for_mod  TO  foreflag.

  loop at p0540 WHERE  pernr = pernr-pernr.
    check p0540-dptid = 'X' .
*     CLEAR e_record_05.

    if Seq_num > 12.
      Seq_num = Seq_num mod 12.
      count_num = count_num + 1.
      append e_record_05.
      CLEAR e_record_05.
    endif.
    MOVE pernr-pernr            TO  e_record_05-pernr.
    MOVE c_record_04-bukrs      TO  e_record_05-bukrs.
    MOVE : 'E'                  TO  e_record_05-r_modif,
           '20'                 TO  e_record_05-d_modif,
           c_record_04-tax_off  TO  e_record_05-tax_off,
           c_record_04-seqno    TO  e_record_05-seqno.
    MOVE : c_record_04-stcd2    TO  e_record_05-stcd2,
           space                TO  e_record_05-pre_space.
    MOVE : c_record_04-regno    TO  e_record_05-regno.
    MOVE   c_record_04-for_mod  TO  foreflag.
***************************************
    concatenate 'e_record_05-RELATION_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <Relation>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-NAME_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <Name>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-RES_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <Reg_no>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-FOREIGNER_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <forei>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-BASCIDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <bas_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-HADIDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <had_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-CHILDDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <chi_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-INSURDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <ins_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-MEDICDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <med_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-EDUCADED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <edu_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-CREDIDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <cre_ded>.
************************************
    <Relation>  = p0540-DPTYP .
    concatenate  p0540-lnmhg p0540-fnmhg into str_tmp .
    <Name> = str_tmp.
    <Reg_no> = p0540-REGNO.
    <forei> =  foreflag.

    call function 'HRPADKR_CALCULATE_AGE_BY_REGNO'
      EXPORTING
        regno                         = p0540-REGNO
        evaluation_date               = age_endda
      IMPORTING
        age_years                     = age_years
      EXCEPTIONS
        evaluation_date_lt_birth_date = 1.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      PERFORM error_handling USING pernr-pernr '402'
                                  space space space space.
      REJECT.
    ENDIF.

    if  P0540-DPTID = 'X'.
      IF age_years <= 20.
        <bas_ded> = checkval.
      ELSEIF ( p0540-REGNO+6(1) CA '246' AND age_years >= 55 ) OR
             ( p0540-REGNO+6(1) CA '135' AND age_years >= 60 ).
        <bas_ded> = checkval.
      ELSE.
        <bas_ded> = checkspa.
      endif.
    else.
      <bas_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.
    if P0540-HNDID = 'X'.
      <had_ded> = checkval.
    else.
      <had_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.
    if ( P0540-CHDID = 'X' and age_years <= 6 ).
      <chi_ded> = checkval.
    else.
      <chi_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.
    if P0540-INSID = 'X'.
      <ins_ded> = checkval.
    else.
      <ins_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.
    if P0540-MEDID = 'X'.
      <med_ded> = checkval.
    else.
      <med_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.
    if P0540-EDUID = 'X'.
      <edu_ded> = checkval.
    else.
      <edu_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.
    if P0540-CREID = 'X'.
      <cre_ded> = checkval.
    else.
      <cre_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.
    MOVE count_num TO e_record_05-seri_no.
    MOVE space TO e_record_05-Space_05.
    Seq_num = Seq_num + 1.
*     append e_record_05.
  endloop.
  append e_record_05.
ENDFORM. " fill_e_record_05
* end legal change 2005 nis 893541

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  write_to_temse_2005
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
* For legal change 2005 nis 893541
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* begin legal change 2005 nis 893541
FORM write_to_temse_2005 .
  CHECK temse_open = true.
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2005 USING 'A'.

  SORT b_record BY bukrs seqno.
* SORT c_record_04 BY bukrs tax_off seqno.
  SORT c_record_04 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.
  SORT d_record BY bukrs tax_off seqno d_seqno.
* begin legal change 2005 nis 893541
  Sort e_record_05 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.
* end legal change 2005 nis 893541
  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2005 USING 'B'.
    LOOP AT c_record_04 WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                        AND stcd2     = b_record-stcd2
                        AND bukrs     = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2005 USING 'C'.
      LOOP AT d_record  WHERE pernr = c_record_04-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2005 USING 'D'.
*        LOOP AT e_record_05 where pernr = d_record-pernr.
*          PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2005 USING 'E'.
*        ENDLOOP. " LOOP FOR e_record_05
      ENDLOOP.
      LOOP AT e_record_05 where pernr = c_record_04-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2005 USING 'E'.
      ENDLOOP. " LOOP FOR e_record_05
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " write_to_temse_2005
* end legal change 2005 nis 893541

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  write_to_temse_record_2005
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_7416   text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_record_2005 USING recordname.
  CLEAR   datafileb.
  REFRESH datafileb.

  CASE recordname.
    WHEN 'A'.
      PERFORM add_arecord_to_datafile_2004.
    WHEN 'B'.
      PERFORM add_brecord_to_datafile_2004.
    WHEN 'C'.
      PERFORM add_crecord_to_datafile_2005.                 "NAN574236
    WHEN 'D'.
      PERFORM add_drecord_to_datafile_2004.
    when 'E'.
      perform add_erecord_to_datafile_2005.
  ENDCASE.
  CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
    EXPORTING
      fbhandle = objhd
    TABLES
      datatab  = datafileb.

ENDFORM. " write_to_temse_record_2005

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  add_crecord_to_datafile_2005
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_crecord_to_datafile_2005 .
  MOVE : c_record_04-r_modif         TO  datafileb+0(1),
          c_record_04-d_modif         TO  datafileb+1(2),
          c_record_04-tax_off         TO  datafileb+3(3),
          c_record_04-seqno           TO  datafileb+6(6),
          c_record_04-stcd2           TO  datafileb+12(10),
          c_record_04-pre_com_num     TO  datafileb+22(2),
          c_record_04-rsd_mod         TO  datafileb+24(1),
          c_record_04-curcd           TO  datafileb+25(2),
          c_record_04-tax_method      TO  datafileb+27(1),
          c_record_04-y_begda         TO  datafileb+28(8),
          c_record_04-y_endda         TO  datafileb+36(8),
          c_record_04-ename           TO  datafileb+44(30),
          c_record_04-for_mod         TO  datafileb+74(1),

  FIELD-SYMBOLS <edu_nts> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <cre_nts> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <cas_nts> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <ins_etc> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <med_etc> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <edu_etc> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <cre_etc> type any.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <don_etc> type any.

  Data: Seq_num(4) type n,
        count_num(2) type n,
        foreflag type n,
        checkval TYPE c VALUE '1',
        checkspa TYPE c VALUE space,
        age_endda  like p0001-begda,        " for the age
        AGE_YEARS TYPE P,
        str_tmp type string.

  CLEAR e_record_05.
  Seq_num = 1.
  count_num = 1.
* the age is calculated basing on the last day of taxation year.
  age_endda      = taxation_year+0(4).
  age_endda+4(4) = '1231'.

  LOOP AT family WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr.
    if Seq_num > 5.
      Seq_num = Seq_num mod 5.
      count_num = count_num + 1.
      append e_record_05.
      CLEAR e_record_05.
    endif.

    MOVE pernr-pernr            TO  e_record_05-pernr.
    MOVE c_record_04-bukrs      TO  e_record_05-bukrs.
    MOVE : 'E'                  TO  e_record_05-r_modif,
           '20'                 TO  e_record_05-d_modif,
           c_record_04-tax_off  TO  e_record_05-tax_off,
           c_record_04-seqno    TO  e_record_05-seqno.
    MOVE : c_record_04-stcd2    TO  e_record_05-stcd2.
    MOVE : c_record_04-regno    TO  e_record_05-regno.
    MOVE   c_record_04-for_mod  TO  foreflag.
************************************************************
    concatenate 'e_record_05-RELATION_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <Relation>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-NAME_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <Name>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-RES_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <Reg_no>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-FOREIGNER_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <forei>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-BASCIDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <bas_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-HADIDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <had_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-CHILDDED_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <chi_ded>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-INSURNTS_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <ins_nts>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-MEDICNTS_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <med_nts>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-EDUCANTS_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <edu_nts>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-CREDINTS_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <cre_nts>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-CASHNTS_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <cas_nts>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-INSURETC_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <ins_etc>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-MEDICETC_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <med_etc>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-EDUCAETC_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <edu_etc>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-CREDIETC_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <cre_etc>.
    concatenate 'e_record_05-DONATETC_' Seq_num into str_tmp.
    assign (str_tmp) to <don_etc>.

    <Relation>  = family-relat .
    IF family-relat = '0'.
      <Name> = c_record_04-ename.
    ELSE.
      <Name> = family-fname.
    ENDIF.
    <Reg_no> = family-regno.
    <forei> = family-forei.

    if family-dptid = 'O'.
      <bas_ded> = checkval.
    ELSE.
      <bas_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.

    if family-hndid = 'O'.
      <had_ded> = checkval.
    else.
      <had_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.

    if family-chdid = 'O'.
      <chi_ded> = checkval.
    else.
      <chi_ded> = checkspa.
    endif.

    <ins_nts> = family-insna * 100.
    <med_nts> = family-medna * 100.
    <edu_nts> = family-eduna * 100.
    <cre_nts> = family-crena * 100.
    <cas_nts> = family-casna * 100.
    <ins_etc> = family-insot * 100.
    <med_etc> = family-medot * 100.
    <edu_etc> = family-eduot * 100.
    <cre_etc> = family-creot * 100.
    <don_etc> = family-donot * 100.

    MOVE count_num TO e_record_05-seri_no.
    MOVE space TO e_record_05-Space_06.

    Seq_num = Seq_num + 1.

  endloop.
  append e_record_05.
endform. " fill_e_record_06
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  write_to_temse_2006
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_2006.
  CHECK temse_open = true.
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2006 USING 'A'.

  SORT b_record BY bukrs seqno.
  SORT c_record_04 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.
  SORT d_record BY bukrs tax_off seqno d_seqno d_seqno.
  Sort e_record_05 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno seri_no.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2006 USING 'B'.

    LOOP AT c_record_04 WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                        AND stcd2     = b_record-stcd2
                        AND bukrs     = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2006 USING 'C'.

      LOOP AT d_record  WHERE pernr = c_record_04-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2006 USING 'D'.       "YEA2006
      ENDLOOP.

      LOOP AT e_record_05 where pernr = c_record_04-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2006 USING 'E'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " write_to_temse_2006

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  write_to_temse_record_2006
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->recordname   IN (A, B, C, D, E)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_record_2006 USING recordname.
  CLEAR   datafileb.
  REFRESH datafileb.

  CASE recordname.
    WHEN 'A'.
      PERFORM add_arecord_to_datafile_2004.
    WHEN 'B'.
      PERFORM add_brecord_to_datafile_2004.
    WHEN 'C'.
      PERFORM add_crecord_to_datafile_2006.
    WHEN 'D'.
      PERFORM add_drecord_to_datafile_2004.
    when 'E'.
      perform add_erecord_to_datafile_2006.
  ENDCASE.
  CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
    EXPORTING
      fbhandle = objhd
    TABLES
      datatab  = datafileb.
ENDFORM. " write_to_temse_record_2006

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  write_to_temse_2007 "BAIW1125745
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_2007.
  CHECK temse_open = true.
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2007 USING 'A'.

  SORT b_record BY bukrs seqno.
  SORT c_record_04 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.
  SORT d_record BY bukrs tax_off seqno d_seqno d_seqno.
  Sort e_record_05 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno seri_no.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2007 USING 'B'.

    LOOP AT c_record_04 WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                        AND stcd2     = b_record-stcd2
                        AND bukrs     = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2007 USING 'C'.

      LOOP AT d_record  WHERE pernr = c_record_04-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2007 USING 'D'.       "YEA2006
      ENDLOOP.

      LOOP AT e_record_05 where pernr = c_record_04-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2007 USING 'E'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " write_to_temse_2007

*BAIW1125745 YEA2007 Phase II
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  write_to_temse_record_2007
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->recordname   IN (A, B, C, D, E)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_record_2007 USING recordname.
  CLEAR   datafileb_07.
  REFRESH datafileb_07.

  CASE recordname.
    WHEN 'A'.
      PERFORM add_arecord_to_datafile_2007.
    WHEN 'B'.
      PERFORM add_brecord_to_datafile_2007.
    WHEN 'C'.
      PERFORM add_crecord_to_datafile_2007.
    WHEN 'D'.
      PERFORM add_drecord_to_datafile_2007.
    when 'E'.
      perform add_erecord_to_datafile_2007.
  ENDCASE.
  CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
    EXPORTING
      fbhandle = objhd
    TABLES
      datatab  = datafileb_07.
ENDFORM. "write_to_temse_record_2007

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                  FILL_B_RECORD_08                                    *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_b_record_08.
  STATICS:
    seq     TYPE i.
  DATA:
    num(12) TYPE n.

  CLEAR b_record.

  READ TABLE bupla_detail_tab WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  MOVE  bupla_detail_tab-bukrs      TO b_record-bukrs.

* Record class, Data class and Tax office
  MOVE: 'B'                         TO b_record-r_modif,
        '20'                        TO b_record-d_modif,
        c_record_08-tax_off         TO b_record-tax_off.

* Serial number
  SORT b_record BY tax_off stcd2 seqno DESCENDING.
  LOOP AT b_record WHERE tax_off = bupla_detail_tab-taxoff
                     AND stcd2   = bupla_detail_tab-stcd2.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    b_record-seqno = 0.
  ELSE.
    seq = seq + 1.
    b_record-seqno = seq.
  ENDIF.

* Biz number, Company name, Name of president and Legal body number
  MOVE: bupla_detail_tab-stcd2      TO b_record-stcd2,
        bupla_detail_tab-name       TO b_record-comnm,
        bupla_detail_tab-kr_repres  TO b_record-repres,
        bupla_detail_tab-stcd1      TO b_record-stcd1.

* Num of c records
  MOVE: 1                           TO b_record-c_rec_num.

* Num of d records
  MOVE: 0                           TO b_record-d_rec_num.
  LOOP AT d_record WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr.
    b_record-d_rec_num = b_record-d_rec_num + 1.
  ENDLOOP.

* Total tax amount and Total income tax
  move_cnp c_record_08-tax_gross  b_record-tot_income.
  move_cnp c_record_08-dtr_itax   b_record-inc_tax.

* Total corporation tax
  MOVE: '0000000000000'             TO b_record-legal_tax.

* Resident tax, Special tax and Total tax
  move_cnp c_record_08-dtr_stax   b_record-spe_tax.
  move_cnp c_record_08-dtr_rtax   b_record-res_tax.
  move_cnp c_record_08-dtr_tot    b_record-tot_tax.

*<<< N1415937
  IF p_annu EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '1' TO b_record-code_submit_pd.
  ELSEIF p_susp EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '2' TO b_record-code_submit_pd.
  ELSEIF p_part EQ 'X'.
    MOVE '3' TO b_record-code_submit_pd.
  ENDIF.
*>>> N1415937

  MOVE space                        TO b_record-bspace_8.

  COLLECT b_record.
ENDFORM. " FILL_B_RECORD_08
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  fill_c_record_08
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_c_record_08 .
  DATA:
    count                 TYPE i,
    tax_method            TYPE c.
  DATA:
    seq_num(2)            TYPE n,
    lv_tot_amt            LIKE pc207-betrg,
    lv_tot_amt_c(11)      TYPE c,                       "N2385821
    lv_amt_c(11)          TYPE c,                       "N2385821
    lv_tot_exm_amt        LIKE pc207-betrg,             "N1536031
    lv_tot_exm_amt_c(11)  TYPE c.                       "N2385821

  CLEAR c_record_08.

* Prepare internal tables
  READ TABLE bupla_detail_tab WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  READ TABLE employee         WITH KEY pernr-pernr.
  READ TABLE otab             WITH KEY pernr-pernr.

* Sequence number
  sort c_record_08 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno descending.
  READ TABLE c_record_08 WITH KEY bukrs   = bupla_detail_tab-bukrs
                                  stcd2   = bupla_detail_tab-stcd2
                                  tax_off = bupla_detail_tab-taxoff.
  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    MOVE c_record_08-seqno TO count.
    count = count + 1.
  ELSE.
    count = 1.
  ENDIF.

* Resient/Non-resident - Foreigner
  CLEAR krtax.
  READ TABLE krtax WITH KEY infty = '0541'.
* Data management number
  MOVE:
    pernr-pernr             TO c_record_08-pernr,
    bupla_detail_tab-bukrs  TO c_record_08-bukrs,
    'C'                     TO c_record_08-r_modif,
    '20'                    TO c_record_08-d_modif.
* Tax office
  MOVE:
    bupla_detail_tab-taxoff TO c_record_08-tax_off.
* Sequence number
  MOVE: count               TO c_record_08-seqno.
* Business number
  MOVE:
    bupla_detail_tab-stcd2  TO c_record_08-stcd2.

* Earner infomation
  PERFORM count_prevous_employer CHANGING c_record_08-pre_com_num.

  IF krtax-rsnot EQ 'X'.
    MOVE: '2'               TO  c_record_08-rsd_mod.    "Non-resident
  ELSE.
    MOVE: '1'               TO  c_record_08-rsd_mod.    "Resident
  ENDIF.

  MOVE: employee-begda      TO c_record_08-y_begda,
        employee-endda      TO c_record_08-y_endda,
        employee-regno      TO c_record_08-regno,
        employee-ename      TO c_record_08-ename,
        employee-r_begda    TO c_record_08-red_begda,
        employee-r_endda    TO c_record_08-red_endda.

  MOVE: space               TO c_record_08-curcd.
  IF krtax-fryea EQ 'X'.
    MOVE: '9'               TO c_record_08-for_mod.   "Foreigner
  ELSE.
    MOVE: '1'               TO c_record_08-for_mod.   "National
  ENDIF.
  IF krtax-rsnot EQ 'X'.
    MOVE: employee-curcd    TO c_record_08-curcd.
  ELSE.
    CLEAR c_record_08-curcd.
  ENDIF.
  IF taxation_year GE 2016.                             "<<<N2385821
    IF employee-n_dispatch = 'O'.
      c_record_08-dispatch = '2'.
    ELSE.
      c_record_08-dispatch = '1'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.                                                ">>>N2385821

  MOVE-CORRESPONDING otab   TO c_record_08.
  IF taxation_year GE '2013'.                           "<<<N1935023
    MOVE: otab-ded_total    TO c_record_08-ded_total_11.
  ENDIF.                                                ">>>N1935023
  MOVE:
    otab-ded_spe_tax_act    TO c_record_08-ded_tot2.

  IF taxation_year GE '2009'.                           "<<<N1415937
    MOVE: otab-earn_cret    TO c_record_08-earn_cret_9,
          otab-tax_assoc    TO c_record_08-tax_assoc_9,
          otab-cret_hous    TO c_record_08-cret_hous_9,
          otab-abrod_inc    TO c_record_08-abrod_inc_9,
          otab-cret_tot     TO c_record_08-cret_tot_9.
  ENDIF.                                                ">>>N1415937

  LOOP AT income WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr AND
                       seqno = 0.
    UNPACK:
      income-regular        TO c_record_08-wtm_gross,
      income-bonus          TO c_record_08-wts_gross,
      income-ackbn          TO c_record_08-wti_gross,
      income-stkbn          TO c_record_08-stock_option,
      income-estok          TO c_record_08-estok,       "N1415937
      income-total          TO c_record_08-gross_tot.
    IF taxation_year GE '2013'.                         "<<<N1935023
      UNPACK: income-sesep  TO c_record_08-sepexced.
    ENDIF.                                              ">>>N1935023
    IF taxation_year GE '2018'.                         "<<<N2685958
      UNPACK: income-ivrwd  TO c_record_08-invrwd.
    ENDIF.                                              ">>>N2685958
  ENDLOOP.

* Read tax calculation method
*<<< N1988026
  MOVE: '2'                 TO c_record_08-tax_method.
  IF employee-flat_rate EQ 'O'.
    MOVE: '1'               TO c_record_08-tax_method.
  ENDIF.
*>>> N1988026
  MOVE: space               TO c_record_08-cspace_8.

  c_record_08-cspace_1 = '0000000000'.
  c_record_08-cspace_2 = '0000000000'.
  c_record_08-cspace_3 = '0000000000'.
  c_record_08-cspace_4 = '00000000'.

* Flag for Company Stock
  IF c_record_08-ded_stck >= 0.
    c_record_08-stck_flag = 0.
  ELSE.
    c_record_08-stck_flag = 1.
  ENDIF.
* Flag for other deduction total
  IF c_record_08-ded_tot2 >= 0.
    c_record_08-tot2_flag = 0.
  ELSE.
    c_record_08-tot2_flag = 1.
  ENDIF.

* Income tax
  IF otab-rem_itax_p > 0.
    c_record_08-rem_itax_flg = 0.
  ELSE.
    c_record_08-rem_itax_flg = 1.
  ENDIF.
* Resident tax
  IF otab-rem_rtax_p > 0.
    c_record_08-rem_rtax_flg = 0.
  ELSE.
    c_record_08-rem_rtax_flg = 1.
  ENDIF.
* Special tax
  IF otab-rem_stax_p > 0.
    c_record_08-rem_stax_flg = 0.
  ELSE.
    c_record_08-rem_stax_flg = 1.
  ENDIF.
* Total
  IF otab-rem_tot_p > 0.
    c_record_08-rem_tot_flg = 0.
  ELSE.
    c_record_08-rem_tot_flg = 1.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM adjust_ntxnf_order.                           "N2385821
  LOOP AT ntx_nf.
    seq_num = seq_num + 1.
    MOVE '0000000000' TO lv_amt_c.                      "N1808708
    LOOP AT ntx_income WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr
                       AND   ntcod = ntx_nf-ntcod
                       AND   NOT amt_cur IS INITIAL.    "N1808708
*<<<N1536031
      MOVE ntx_income-amt_cur TO lv_amt_c.
      IF taxation_year GE 2010 AND ntx_nf-ntexm = 'E'.
        ADD: ntx_income-amt_cur TO lv_tot_exm_amt.
      ELSE.
        ADD: ntx_income-amt_cur TO lv_tot_amt.
      ENDIF.
*>>>N1536031
    ENDLOOP.
    PERFORM assign_value USING 'c_record_08-non_taxa'   "N2385821
                                seq_num lv_amt_c.
  ENDLOOP.
*<<<N1536031
  MOVE: lv_tot_amt              TO lv_tot_amt_c,
        lv_tot_exm_amt          TO lv_tot_exm_amt_c.
*<<<N2385821
  seq_num = seq_num + 1.
  PERFORM assign_value USING 'c_record_08-non_taxa'
                              seq_num lv_tot_amt_c.
  IF taxation_year GE 2010.
    seq_num = seq_num + 1.
    PERFORM assign_value USING 'c_record_08-non_taxa'
                                seq_num lv_tot_exm_amt_c.
  ENDIF.
*>>>N2385821

  IF employee-employed = 'O'.
    c_record_08-yeaty = '1'.
  ELSE.
    c_record_08-yeaty = '2'.
  ENDIF.

  IF employee-hshld = 'O'.
    c_record_08-hshld = '1'.
  ELSE.
    c_record_08-hshld = '2'.
  ENDIF.
  c_record_08-nationcd = employee-nationcd.
  MOVE:
    bupla_detail_tab-name   TO c_record_08-comnm,
    otab-ops_01             TO c_record_08-op_01,
    otab-ops_02             TO c_record_08-op_02,
    otab-ops_03             TO c_record_08-op_03,
    otab-ops_04             TO c_record_08-op_04,
    otab-rps_01             TO c_record_08-rp_01,
    otab-rps_02             TO c_record_08-rp_02,
    otab-ins_01             TO c_record_08-si_01,
    otab-ins_02             TO c_record_08-si_02,
    otab-ins_03             TO c_record_08-si_03,
    otab-ins_04             TO c_record_08-si_04,
    otab-hous_fee           TO c_record_08-monrt,
    otab-hss_01             TO c_record_08-hs_01,
    otab-hss_02             TO c_record_08-hs_02,

FORM fill_d_record_08.
  DATA:
    num                   TYPE i,
    tembuznum             LIKE p0542-bus01.
*<<< N1415937
  DATA:
    seq_num(2)            TYPE n,
    lv_tot_amt            LIKE pc207-betrg,
    lv_tot_amt_c(11)      TYPE c,                       "N2385821
    lv_amt_c(11)          TYPE c,                       "N2385821
    lv_tot_exm_amt        LIKE pc207-betrg,             "N1536031
    lv_tot_exm_amt_c(11)  TYPE c.                       "N2385821
*>>> N1415937

  num  = 0.
  LOOP AT income WHERE seqno > 0 AND pernr = pernr-pernr.
    CLEAR: d_record, seq_num, lv_tot_amt.               "N1415937
    CLEAR: lv_tot_exm_amt.                              "N1693043
    num = num + 1.              "Num of records(per employee)

    MOVE:
      pernr-pernr           TO d_record-pernr,
      c_record_08-bukrs     TO d_record-bukrs.

* Record class, Data class, Tax office, Serial number and Resident number
    MOVE:
      'D'                   TO d_record-r_modif,
      '20'                  TO d_record-d_modif,
      c_record_08-tax_off   TO d_record-tax_off,
      c_record_08-seqno     TO d_record-seqno,
      c_record_08-stcd2     TO d_record-stcd2,
      space                 TO d_record-pre_space,
      c_record_08-regno     TO d_record-regno.

* Company name
    MOVE: income-workplace  TO d_record-workplace.

* Business Number
    MOVE: income-buzinum    TO tembuznum.
    DO.
      REPLACE '-'  WITH '' INTO tembuznum.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    CONDENSE tembuznum NO-GAPS.
    MOVE: tembuznum         TO d_record-buzinum.
    UNPACK:
      income-regular        TO d_record-regular_1,      "Regular pay
      income-bonus          TO d_record-bonus_1,        "Bonus
      income-ackbn          TO d_record-ibn01_1,        "Ack. bonus
      income-stkbn          TO d_record-stock_option,   "Stock option
      income-estok          TO  d_record-estok,         "EE Stock
      income-total          TO d_record-total_1.        "Income total
    IF taxation_year GE '2013'.                         "<<<N1935023
      UNPACK: income-sesep  TO d_record-sepexced.
    ENDIF.                                              ">>>N1935023
    IF taxation_year GE '2018'.                         "<<<N2685958
      UNPACK: income-ivrwd  TO d_record-invrwd.
    ENDIF.                                              ">>>N2685958
    MOVE:
      num                   TO d_record-d_seqno,      "Serial No.
      space                 TO d_record-dspace_8.

*<<< N1415937
    WRITE:
      income-rtbeg+0(4)     TO d_record-rtbeg+0(4),
      income-rtbeg+4(2)     TO d_record-rtbeg+4(2),
      income-rtbeg+6(2)     TO d_record-rtbeg+6(2),
      income-rtend+0(4)     TO d_record-rtend+0(4),
      income-rtend+4(2)     TO d_record-rtend+4(2),
      income-rtend+6(2)     TO d_record-rtend+6(2),
      income-exbeg+0(4)     TO d_record-exbeg+0(4),
      income-exbeg+4(2)     TO d_record-exbeg+4(2),
      income-exbeg+6(2)     TO d_record-exbeg+6(2),
      income-exend+0(4)     TO d_record-exend+0(4),
      income-exend+4(2)     TO d_record-exend+4(2),
      income-exend+6(2)     TO d_record-exend+6(2).
*>>> N1415937

    LOOP AT ntx_nf.
      seq_num = seq_num + 1.
      MOVE '0000000000' TO lv_amt_c.                    "N1808708
      LOOP AT ntx_income_prv WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr
                             AND   bizno = income-buzinum
                             AND   ntcod = ntx_nf-ntcod
                             AND   begda = income-rtbeg "N1693043
                             AND   endda = income-rtend "N1693043
                             AND   NOT amt IS INITIAL.  "N1808708
        "<<<N1536031
        MOVE ntx_income_prv-amt TO lv_amt_c.
        IF taxation_year GE 2010 AND ntx_nf-ntexm = 'E'.
          ADD: ntx_income_prv-amt TO lv_tot_exm_amt.
        ELSE.
          ADD: ntx_income_prv-amt TO lv_tot_amt.
        ENDIF.
        ">>>N1536031
      ENDLOOP.
      PERFORM assign_value USING 'd_record-non_taxa'    "N2385821
                                  seq_num lv_amt_c.
    ENDLOOP.
*<<<N1536031
    MOVE: lv_tot_amt        TO lv_tot_amt_c.
    MOVE: lv_tot_exm_amt    TO lv_tot_exm_amt_c.
"<<< N2385821
    seq_num = seq_num + 1.
    PERFORM assign_value USING 'd_record-non_taxa'
                                seq_num lv_tot_amt_c.
    IF taxation_year GE 2010.
      seq_num = seq_num + 1.
      PERFORM assign_value USING 'd_record-non_taxa'
                                  seq_num lv_tot_exm_amt_c.
    ENDIF.

*<<< N2385821
*<<< N1415937
    UNPACK:
      income-intax          TO d_record-intax,          "Income tax
      income-retax          TO d_record-retax,          "Resident tax
      income-sptax          TO d_record-sptax,          "Special tax
      income-tltax          TO d_record-tltax.          "Total tax
*>>> N1415937
*<<< N1536031
    IF income-txpas = 'X'.                              "N1693043
      d_record-txprt = '1'.
    ELSE.
      d_record-txprt = '2'.

*>>> N1536031

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  write_to_temse_2008
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text: note1289311
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_2008.
  CHECK temse_open = true.
  PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2008 USING 'A'.

*>>> JINQUE1309392 Sort B record by Biz Number,identical to Don and Med
  SORT b_record BY bukrs stcd2.
* SORT b_record BY bukrs seqno.
*<<< JINQUE1309392
  SORT c_record_08 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno.
  SORT d_record BY bukrs tax_off seqno d_seqno d_seqno.
  Sort e_record_05 by bukrs tax_off stcd2 seqno seri_no.

  LOOP AT b_record WHERE bukrs = a_record-bukrs.
    MOVE: sy-tabix TO b_record-seqno.                     "JINQUE1309392
    PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2008 USING 'B'.

    LOOP AT c_record_08 WHERE tax_off = b_record-tax_off
                        AND stcd2     = b_record-stcd2
                        AND bukrs     = b_record-bukrs.
      PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2008 USING 'C'.

      LOOP AT d_record  WHERE pernr = c_record_08-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2008 USING 'D'.
      ENDLOOP.

      LOOP AT e_record_05 where pernr = c_record_08-pernr.
        PERFORM write_to_temse_record_2008 USING 'E'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " write_to_temse_2008

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  write_to_temse_record_2008
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text: note1289311
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM write_to_temse_record_2008 USING recordname.
  CLEAR   datafileb_08.
  REFRESH datafileb_08.

  CASE recordname.
    WHEN 'A'.
      PERFORM add_arecord_to_datafile_2008.
    WHEN 'B'.
      PERFORM add_brecord_to_datafile_2008.
    WHEN 'C'.
      PERFORM add_crecord_to_datafile_2008.
    WHEN 'D'.
      PERFORM add_drecord_to_datafile_2008.
    when 'E'.
      perform add_erecord_to_datafile_2008.
  ENDCASE.
  CALL FUNCTION 'RSTS_WRITE'
    EXPORTING
      fbhandle = objhd
    TABLES
      datatab  = datafileb_08.
ENDFORM. " write_to_temse_record_2008

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*              ADD_ARECORD_TO_DATAFILE_2008                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text: note1289311
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_arecord_to_datafile_2008.
  MOVE :   a_record-r_modif        TO datafileb_08+0(1),
           a_record-d_modif        TO datafileb_08+1(2),
           a_record-tax_off        TO datafileb_08+3(3),
           a_record-submitdt       TO datafileb_08+6(8),
           a_record-agency         TO datafileb_08+14(1),
           a_record-agent_num      TO datafileb_08+15(6),
           a_record-home_tax_id    TO datafileb_08+21(20),
           a_record-aspace_1       TO datafileb_08+41(4),
           a_record-stcd2          TO datafileb_08+45(10),
           a_record-comnm          TO datafileb_08+55(40),
           a_record-sub_dept       TO datafileb_08+95(30),
           a_record-sub_name       TO datafileb_08+125(30),
           a_record-ag_telnr       TO datafileb_08+155(15).

  UNPACK   a_record-b_rec_num      TO datafileb_08+170(5).

  MOVE :   a_record-hangle_code    TO datafileb_08+175(3),
           a_record-target_prd     TO datafileb_08+178(1),
           a_record-aspace_8       TO datafileb_08+179(641).

  IF cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize > 1.
    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb_08+0(41)  41.
    MOVE out_xstring TO  adj_xstring.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb_08+41(54) 54.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb_08+95(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb_08+125(30) 30.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb_08+155(665) 665.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafileb_08. REFRESH datafileb_08.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafileb_08.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafileb_08.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM. "add_arecord_to_datafile_2008

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

    CLEAR  out_xstring.  CLEAR  adj_string. CLEAR  adj_xstring.
* Convert unicode string to hex stream
    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb_08+0(62)  62.

    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.

    PERFORM unistring_to_xstring USING   datafileb_08+92(728) 728.
    CONCATENATE adj_xstring out_xstring INTO adj_xstring IN BYTE MODE.
* Comvert hex stream to unicode string
    PERFORM  xstring_to_unistring.
    CLEAR datafileb_08. REFRESH datafileb_08.
    APPEND adj_string TO datafileb_08.
* Unicode end
  ELSE.
    APPEND datafileb_08.
