    space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa30   10
    space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa31   10
    space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa32   10
    space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  IF taxation_year GE '2016'.                       "<<<N2385821
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa33 10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa34 10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa35 10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ELSEIF taxation_year EQ '2015'.
    PERFORM add_field USING lv_space          10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa33 10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ENDIF.                                            ">>>N2385821
  IF taxation_year GE '2019'.                       "<<<N2858465
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa36  10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa37  10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa38  10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa39  10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.    ">>>N2858465
  ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2018'.                   "<<<N2685958
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa36 10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING lv_space          10  "Spaces
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING lv_space          10  "Spaces
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa37 10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
    PERFORM add_field USING ls_ntx-non_taxa38 10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ELSEIF taxation_year GE '2016'.
    PERFORM add_field USING lv_space          10
      space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ENDIF.                                            ">>>N2685958
ENDFORM. " SET_NON_TAXABLE_D19
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  SET_NON_TAXABLE_20
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N2996244
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_non_taxable_20 USING is_entry
                              iv_num TYPE i " total non-taxable item
                              iv_spb TYPE i " space before subtotal
                              iv_spa TYPE i " space after subtotal
                     CHANGING cv_dme TYPE ty_dme_line
                              cv_pos TYPE i.
  DATA:
    lv_index          TYPE numc2,
    lv_field          TYPE fieldname,
    lv_space(10)      TYPE n VALUE '0000000000',
    lv_tmp            TYPE i,"Temp start position
    ls_ntx            TYPE non_taxable_dme.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS:
    <fv_field>        TYPE any.

* Initial numbers of the year
  MOVE-CORRESPONDING is_entry TO ls_ntx.

* fill non-taxable amount
  DO iv_num TIMES.
    lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    CONCATENATE 'NON_TAXA' lv_index INTO lv_field.
    UNASSIGN <fv_field>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field OF STRUCTURE ls_ntx TO <fv_field>.
    CHECK <fv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
    PERFORM add_field USING <fv_field> 10 space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ENDDO.

* fill space before subtotal
  DO iv_spb TIMES.
    PERFORM add_field USING lv_space 10 space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ENDDO.

* subtotal of non-taxable and exemption
  DO 2 TIMES.
    lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    CONCATENATE 'NON_TAXA' lv_index INTO lv_field.
    UNASSIGN <fv_field>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field OF STRUCTURE ls_ntx TO <fv_field>.
    CHECK <fv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
    PERFORM add_field USING <fv_field> 10 space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ENDDO.

* fill space after subtotal
  DO iv_spa TIMES.
    PERFORM add_field USING lv_space 10 space space CHANGING cv_dme cv_pos lv_tmp.
  ENDDO.
ENDFORM. " SET_NON_TAXABLE_20
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  ASSIGN_VALUE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Create by N2385821 YEA DME 2016
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM assign_value USING p_prefix TYPE string
                   VALUE(p_num)    TYPE n
                   VALUE(p_amt_c)  TYPE c.
  DATA: lv_str_tmp     TYPE string.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs>  TYPE any.

  CONCATENATE p_prefix p_num INTO lv_str_tmp.
  ASSIGN (lv_str_tmp) TO <fs>.
  IF <fs> IS ASSIGNED.
    MOVE p_amt_c TO <fs>.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  MAKE_DON_LIST
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N2584059
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_don_list.
  DATA: lv_tax_method     TYPE c,                              "N2609401
        l_subrc           LIKE sy-subrc.

  PERFORM check_tax_method CHANGING lv_tax_method.             "N2609401
  CHECK lv_tax_method <> 'A'."no H or I record for foreigner A "N2609401

* get donation information
  CLEAR gt_p0858.
  REFRESH: gt_p0858[].
  CALL FUNCTION 'HR_READ_INFOTYPE'
    EXPORTING
      pernr           = otab-pernr
      infty           = '0858'
      begda           = tax_begda
      endda           = tax_endda
    IMPORTING
      subrc           = l_subrc
    TABLES
      infty_tab       = gt_p0858[]
    EXCEPTIONS
      infty_not_found = 1
      OTHERS          = 2.

*<<< N2290268 do not add content after 2290268
  IF gv_pipa_switch EQ abap_true AND datamed EQ 'X'.
    CALL METHOD gr_rgbzn->decrypt_table
      EXPORTING
        iv_field = 'DONUM'
      CHANGING
        ct_table = gt_p0858[]
      EXCEPTIONS
        DECRYPTION_ERROR = 1
        OTHERS           = 2.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      PERFORM error_handling USING pernr-pernr '410'
                                   pernr-pernr space space space.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
*>>> N2290268

* Read foreigner
  CLEAR krtax.
  READ TABLE krtax WITH KEY infty = '0541'.

* prepare for H record
  PERFORM get_adjust_don.

*<<< N2609401 get Korean text of Lump-sum donation by Employer
  IF gv_don_name IS INITIAL.
    PERFORM get_text_symbol
      USING 'HKRCYEA0' '3' 'D07' CHANGING gv_don_name.
    CONDENSE gv_don_name NO-GAPS.
  ENDIF.
*>>> N2609401

* prepare for I record
  PERFORM get_detail_don.
ENDFORM. " MAKE_DON_LIST
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GET_ADJUST_DON
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N2584059
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_adjust_don.
  DATA: lv_don_ded        TYPE pc207-betrg,
        const(5)          TYPE c,
        don_amt           TYPE p0858-doamt,
        prev_ded_amt      TYPE p0858-doamt,
        deductible_amt    TYPE p0858-doamt,
        curr_ded_amt      TYPE p0858-doamt,
        carryover_amt     TYPE p0858-doamt,
        expired_amt       TYPE p0858-doamt,
        lv_stand_ded(1)   TYPE c.

  REFRESH adjust_don[].
* RT is from YEA payroll, backup in make_ntx_income
  SORT rt BY lgart cntr1 v0znr ASCENDING.

* Constant limit
  PERFORM re511p USING '41' 'LDDON' tax_endda.
*<<< Donation wage type /Y5S and /Y5J
  LOOP AT rt WHERE lgart = pkr99_wty_ded_calc_dona
             OR    lgart = pkr99_wty_poldon_tax_credit.
    lv_don_ded = lv_don_ded + rt-betrg.
  ENDLOOP.
  CHECK lv_don_ded >= t511p-betrg.

  CLEAR: lv_stand_ded."get standard tax credit information
  READ TABLE rt WITH KEY lgart = pkr99_wty_ded_std_spec.
  IF sy-subrc = 0 AND rt-betrg > 0.
    lv_stand_ded = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

* Get donation from /Y64 data
  LOOP AT rt WHERE lgart = pkr99_wty_ded_carr_dona_nxt
    AND cntr1 <> pkr99_political_donation.
    CLEAR: adjust_don, don_amt, deductible_amt, curr_ded_amt,
           expired_amt, carryover_amt.

    MOVE pernr-pernr TO adjust_don-pernr.
    adjust_don-code = rt-cntr1.
    IF rt-v0znr IS NOT INITIAL.
      adjust_don-year = taxation_year - rt-v0znr + 1.
    ELSE.
      adjust_don-year = taxation_year.
    ENDIF.

    CASE adjust_don-code.
      WHEN: pkr99_legal_donation.
        const = 'LGCOL'.
      WHEN: pkr99_designation_donation.
        const = 'DECOL'.
      WHEN: pkr99_religious_donation.
        const = 'RECOL'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
    ENDCASE.
    PERFORM re511k_without_dump using '41' const tax_endda.

    don_amt        = rt-betpe + rt-anzhl + rt-betrg.
    prev_ded_amt   = rt-anzhl.
    deductible_amt = rt-betpe + rt-betrg.
    curr_ded_amt   = rt-betpe.

    "current year donation when standard tax credit
    IF lv_stand_ded = 'X' AND adjust_don-year = taxation_year.
      IF adjust_don-code = pkr99_ee_stock_donation.
        expired_amt = rt-betrg."undeducted in EE stock
      ELSE.
        CLEAR: curr_ded_amt.
        expired_amt = rt-betpe."deducted in legal and designation
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      "compare the carry-over year
      IF rt-v0znr > t511k-kwert.
        expired_amt = rt-betrg.
      ELSEIF rt-v0znr <= t511k-kwert.
        carryover_amt = rt-betrg.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

*   For currency display
    put_value: don_amt        adjust_don-don_amt,
               prev_ded_amt   adjust_don-prev_ded_amt,
               deductible_amt adjust_don-deductible_amt,
               curr_ded_amt   adjust_don-curr_ded_amt,
               carryover_amt  adjust_don-carryover_amt,
               expired_amt    adjust_don-expired_amt.
    APPEND adjust_don.
  ENDLOOP.

* Political
  CLEAR: adjust_don, don_amt, deductible_amt, curr_ded_amt, expired_amt.
* no original data in payroll, only in infotype
  LOOP AT gt_p0858 WHERE docod = pkr99_political_donation.
    don_amt = don_amt + gt_p0858-doamt.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF don_amt > 0.
    deductible_amt = don_amt.
    READ TABLE rt WITH KEY lgart = pkr99_wty_poldon_tax_credit. "/Y5J
    IF sy-subrc = 0."deduction up to 100000KRW
      curr_ded_amt = curr_ded_amt + rt-betrg.
    ENDIF.
    READ TABLE rt WITH KEY lgart = pkr99_wty_ded_carr_dona_nxt  "/Y64
      cntr1 = pkr99_political_donation.
    IF sy-subrc = 0."deduction over 100000KRW
      curr_ded_amt = curr_ded_amt + rt-betpe.
    ENDIF.
    expired_amt = deductible_amt - curr_ded_amt.

    MOVE: pernr-pernr              TO adjust_don-pernr,
          pkr99_political_donation TO adjust_don-code,
          taxation_year            TO adjust_don-year.
    put_value: don_amt        adjust_don-don_amt,
               deductible_amt adjust_don-deductible_amt,
               curr_ded_amt   adjust_don-curr_ded_amt,
               expired_amt    adjust_don-expired_amt.
    APPEND adjust_don.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " GET_ADJUST_DON
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GET_DETAIL_DON
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N2584059
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_detail_don.
  DATA: lt_detail_don LIKE detail_don[],
        lv_amount     LIKE p0858-doamt,
        lv_mul_union  TYPE flag,
        lv_donam      LIKE p0858-donam,                        "N2609401
        ls_depif      TYPE pkr_yea_dep_inf.                    "N3016355

  REFRESH detail_don[].
  SORT gt_p0858 BY docod depty ASCENDING.

  PERFORM get_t7kr5a USING '0858' tax_endda.

  LOOP AT gt_p0858 WHERE crvin <> 'X'."filter carry-over
* Check available subtype
    READ TABLE gt_t7kr5a WITH KEY subty = gt_p0858-docod.
    IF sy-subrc NE 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.
    CHECK gt_p0858-doamt > 0.

    CLEAR detail_don.
    detail_don-pernr  = gt_p0858-pernr.
    detail_don-code   = gt_p0858-docod.
    detail_don-count  = gt_p0858-docnt.
    detail_don-donnm  = gt_p0858-donam.
    detail_don-biz_no = gt_p0858-donum.
* Hide donation agency name&biz_no. for political donation
    IF gt_p0858-docod = '20'.
       CLEAR: detail_don-donnm, detail_don-biz_no.
    ENDIF.

    CASE gt_p0858-subty.
      WHEN pkr99_legal_donation.
          detail_don-type = TEXT-D01.
      WHEN pkr99_political_donation.
          detail_don-type = TEXT-D02.
      WHEN pkr99_designation_donation.
          detail_don-type = TEXT-D03.
      WHEN pkr99_religious_donation.
          detail_don-type = TEXT-D04.
      WHEN pkr99_ee_stock_donation.
          detail_don-type = TEXT-D05.
    ENDCASE.

*   Donation infomation
    MOVE TEXT-D06          TO detail_don-doninfo.

    PERFORM get_dep_info USING gt_p0858-pernr gt_p0858-depty gt_p0858-depoi CHANGING ls_depif."N3016355

    CASE ls_depif-relat."N3016355
      WHEN:'0'.
        detail_don-donor_type = '1'.
      WHEN:'3'.
        detail_don-donor_type = '2'.
      WHEN:'4' OR '5'.
        detail_don-donor_type = '3'.
      WHEN:'1' OR '2'.
        detail_don-donor_type = '4'.
      WHEN:'6'.
        detail_don-donor_type = '5'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        detail_don-donor_type = '6'.
    ENDCASE.

    detail_don-donor_name  = ls_depif-ename."<<< N3016355
    detail_don-donor_regno = ls_depif-regno.
    detail_don-foreigner   = ls_depif-fryea.">>> N3016355
    detail_don-subty = gt_p0858-depty.
    detail_don-objid = gt_p0858-depoi.

*   Donation deductible amount
    detail_don-donded = gt_p0858-doamt.
*   Gift aid donation
    IF gt_p0858-dogfa > 0.
      detail_don-dongfa = gt_p0858-dogfa.
    ENDIF.
*   Total donation
    lv_amount = gt_p0858-doamt + gt_p0858-dogfa.
    detail_don-amount = lv_amount.
   COLLECT detail_don.
  ENDLOOP.

* Union fee
  PERFORM re511k USING '41' 'DNUFO' tax_endda.
  CLEAR crt.
  READ TABLE crt WITH KEY lgart = pkr99_wtm_union cumty = 'Y'."/156
  IF t511k-kwert IS INITIAL AND sy-subrc = 0 AND crt-betrg <> 0.
    CLEAR detail_don.
    MOVE: pernr-pernr           TO detail_don-pernr.
    MOVE: '40'                  TO detail_don-code,
          '1'                   TO detail_don-donor_type,
          '1'                   TO detail_don-count,
          ' '                   TO detail_don-subty,
          ' '                   TO detail_don-objid,
          TEXT-D03              TO detail_don-type.
    READ TABLE company WITH KEY pernr = pernr-pernr.
    MOVE: company-stcd2         TO detail_don-biz_no,
          company-comnm         TO detail_don-donnm.
*<<< N3016355
    PERFORM get_dep_info USING pernr-pernr space space CHANGING ls_depif.
    MOVE: ls_depif-ename        TO detail_don-donor_name,
          ls_depif-regno        TO detail_don-donor_regno,
          ls_depif-fryea        TO detail_don-foreigner.       "N2609401
*>>> N3016355
    PERFORM get_t512w USING tax_endda.
    IF lines( gt_t512w ) > 0.
* customized in 41BIZ, data from IT0057
      LOOP AT gt_t512w.
* here CRT is the last payroll in tax year, from make_ntx_income
        READ TABLE crt WITH KEY lgart = gt_t512w-lgart cumty = 'Y'.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 and crt-betrg <> 0.
          lv_mul_union = 'X'.
*    Check business number in 41BIZ
          PERFORM check_add_bizno USING gt_t512w-lgart
                               CHANGING detail_don-biz_no
                                        detail_don-donnm.
          lv_amount = - crt-betrg.
          detail_don-amount = detail_don-donded = lv_amount.
          COLLECT detail_don.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
* single union fee, data from IT0014/0015
    IF lv_mul_union IS INITIAL.
      READ TABLE crt WITH KEY lgart = '/156' cumty = 'Y'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 and crt-betrg <> 0.
*    Check business number in 41BIZ
        PERFORM check_add_bizno USING gt_t512w-lgart
                             CHANGING detail_don-biz_no
                                      detail_don-donnm.
        lv_amount = - crt-betrg.
        detail_don-amount = detail_don-donded = lv_amount.
        COLLECT detail_don.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

*<<< N2609401
  SORT detail_don BY pernr code donor_type ASCENDING.
* convert amount to display mode
  LOOP AT detail_don.
    put_value: detail_don-amount detail_don-amount_c,
               detail_don-donded detail_don-donded_c,
               detail_don-dongfa detail_don-dongfa_c.
* clear business number when Lump-sum donation by Employer
    lv_donam = detail_don-donnm.
    CONDENSE lv_donam NO-GAPS.
    IF lv_donam = gv_don_name.
      CLEAR detail_don-biz_no.
    ENDIF.
* put political first
    IF detail_don-code = '20'.
      INSERT detail_don INTO lt_detail_don[] INDEX 1.
    ELSE.
      APPEND detail_don TO lt_detail_don[].
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
*>>> N2609401

  detail_don[] = lt_detail_don[].
ENDFORM. " GET_DETAIL_DON
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GET_DEP_INFO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N3016355
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_dep_info USING iv_pernr TYPE pernr_d
                        iv_subty TYPE subty
                        iv_objps TYPE objps
               CHANGING cs_depif TYPE pkr_yea_dep_inf.

  DATA:
    ls_dep TYPE pkr_yea_dep.

  CLEAR cs_depif.
  IF taxation_year GE '2020'.
    READ TABLE gt_family_detail INTO ls_dep WITH KEY pernr = iv_pernr subty = iv_subty objps = iv_objps.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_dep-info TO cs_depif.
  ELSE.
    READ TABLE family WITH KEY pernr = iv_pernr subty = iv_subty objps = iv_objps.
    MOVE:
      family-fname TO cs_depif-ename,
      family-regno TO cs_depif-regno,
      family-relat TO cs_depif-relat,
      family-forei TO cs_depif-fryea.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " GET_DEP_INFO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

FORM get_t7kr5a USING iv_infty TYPE infty iv_keyda TYPE begda.
  IF NOT ( gt_t7kr5a-infty = iv_infty AND
     gt_t7kr5a-begda <= iv_keyda AND gt_t7kr5a-endda >= iv_keyda ).
    CLEAR gt_t7kr5a.
    REFRESH gt_t7kr5a[].
    SELECT * FROM t7kr5a INTO gt_t7kr5a WHERE infty = iv_infty
      AND begda <= iv_keyda AND endda >= iv_keyda.
      APPEND gt_t7kr5a TO gt_t7kr5a[].
    ENDSELECT.

ENDFORM. " GET_T7KR5A
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GET_T512W
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N2584059
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_t512w USING iv_keyda TYPE begda.
  DATA: lv_xfld TYPE x,
        lv_xkey TYPE x VALUE '01',
        lv_cfld TYPE c.
  IF NOT ( gt_t512w-begda <= iv_keyda AND gt_t512w-endda >= iv_keyda ).
    CLEAR gt_t512w.
    REFRESH gt_t512w[].
    SELECT * FROM t512w INTO gt_t512w WHERE molga = '41'
      AND begda <= iv_keyda AND endda >= iv_keyda.
      lv_xfld = gt_t512w-kumul+6(1).
      lv_cfld = gt_t512w-vklas+29(1).
      IF lv_xfld = lv_xkey AND lv_cfld <> '0'.
        APPEND gt_t512w TO gt_t512w[].
      ENDIF.
    ENDSELECT.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " GET_T512W
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CHECK_ADD_BIZNO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N2584059
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_add_bizno USING p_lgart
                      CHANGING p_biz_no
                               p_biz_name.
  CONSTANTS l_feature_name TYPE t549b-namen  VALUE '41BIZ'.
  DATA: BEGIN OF ecc_tab OCCURS 10,
         back(40)     TYPE c,
        END OF ecc_tab.
  DATA: pmekr         TYPE pmekr.
  DATA: union_fee_wt  TYPE p0014-lgart .
  DATA: l_biz_no      TYPE p0858-donum.
  DATA: l_biz_name    TYPE p0858-donam.

  MOVE p_lgart             TO union_fee_wt.
  MOVE-CORRESPONDING p0001 TO pmekr.
  MOVE '41'                TO pmekr-molga.
  MOVE union_fee_wt        TO pmekr-lgart.

* Get business number & company name via feature 41BIZ
  CALL FUNCTION 'HR_FEATURE_BACKTABLE'
    EXPORTING
      feature                           = l_feature_name
      struc_content                     = pmekr
      kind_of_error                     = '3'
    TABLES
      back                              = ecc_tab
    EXCEPTIONS
      no_backvalue                      = 4
      OTHERS                            = 0.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
     LOOP AT ecc_tab.
       CASE sy-tabix.
         WHEN 1.
           l_biz_no   = ecc_tab-back.
         WHEN 2.
           l_biz_name = ecc_tab-back.
       ENDCASE.
     ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

  IF l_biz_no is not INITIAL.
    DO.
      REPLACE '-' WITH '' INTO l_biz_no.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    CONDENSE l_biz_no NO-GAPS.
    p_biz_no   = l_biz_no.
    p_biz_name = l_biz_name.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM. " CHECK_ADD_BIZNO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FILL_H_RECORD_17
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N2584059
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_h_record_17.
  DATA: lv_lines           TYPE i.

  DESCRIBE TABLE adjust_don LINES lv_lines.
  CHECK lv_lines > 0.
  "reset
  CLEAR h_record.                                         "N2589174
  "fill in h record header info
  MOVE: pernr-pernr          TO h_record-pernr,
        c_record_08-bukrs    TO h_record-bukrs,
        'H'                  TO h_record-record_class,
        '20'                 TO h_record-data_class,
        c_record_08-tax_off  TO h_record-tax_office,
        c_record_08-seqno    TO h_record-serial_no,
        c_record_08-stcd2    TO h_record-biz_no.

* Read adjustment donation data
  SORT adjust_don by pernr code year ASCENDING.           "N1596311
  LOOP AT adjust_don WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr.           "N1596311
*<<< N1683885 if item 16 is 0 then do not generate
    IF adjust_don-don_amt = adjust_don-prev_ded_amt AND
       adjust_don-deductible_amt = 0.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.
*>>> N1683885
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING adjust_don   TO h_record.
* Earner-registration number,name,foreigner
    MOVE: employee-regno            TO h_record-reg_no,
          employee-ename            TO h_record-name,
          c_record_08-for_mod       TO h_record-foreigner,
          adjust_don-code           TO h_record-don_code,
          adjust_don-year           TO h_record-don_year,
          adjust_don-prev_ded_amt   TO h_record-ded_amt_prev,
          adjust_don-deductible_amt TO h_record-deductable_don,
          adjust_don-curr_ded_amt   TO h_record-ded_amt_curr.
    h_record-seq_adj = h_record-seq_adj + 1.
*>>> N1596311
    APPEND h_record.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " FILL_H_RECORD_17
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FILL_I_RECORD_17
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       [CREATE] N2584059
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_i_record_17.
  DATA: ls_detail              LIKE detail_don.

  CLEAR i_record.
  MOVE: pernr-pernr               TO i_record-pernr,
        c_record_08-bukrs         TO i_record-bukrs,
        'I'                       TO i_record-record_class,
        '20'                      TO i_record-data_class,
        c_record_08-tax_off       TO i_record-tax_office,
        c_record_08-seqno         TO i_record-serial_no,
        c_record_08-stcd2         TO i_record-biz_no.
  SORT detail_don BY pernr code donor_type ASCENDING.     "N1596311
  LOOP AT detail_don INTO ls_detail WHERE pernr = pernr-pernr.
    MOVE: employee-regno          TO i_record-reg_no,
          ls_detail-code          TO i_record-don_code,
          '1'                     TO i_record-don_content,"N2685958
          ls_detail-biz_no        TO i_record-biz_no_agency,
          ls_detail-donnm         TO i_record-agency_name,
          ls_detail-donor_type    TO i_record-relation_code,
          ls_detail-donor_regno   TO i_record-donor_reg_no,
          ls_detail-count         TO i_record-count,
          ls_detail-donded_c      TO i_record-don_ded,
          ls_detail-dongfa_c      TO i_record-don_gfa,    "N2385821
          ls_detail-amount_c      TO i_record-don_amt,
          ls_detail-foreigner     TO i_record-foreigner.  "N2609401
          i_record-seq_donor = i_record-seq_donor + 1.
    IF ls_detail-donor_type = '1'.
      MOVE: employee-ename        TO i_record-donor_name.
    ELSE.
      MOVE: ls_detail-donor_name  TO i_record-donor_name.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND i_record.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM. " FILL_I_RECORD_17
